body.name: That
body.construction: This is the all-\(\kappa\) first-order attainer.  Put \(D=[1/2,1]^d\), \(D_h=hD\), and let \(v_s\) be the monomial vector through degree \(\lceil s\rceil-1\), with known \(H_s=\int_Dv_s(z)v_s(z)^{\mathsf T}dz\) and \(\lambda_s=\lambda_{\min}(H_s)\).  If \(n<6\), return \(0\).  Otherwise split the ordered sample deterministically into three blocks \(I_1,I_2,I_3\) whose sizes differ by at most one.  On \(I_1\), set \(\widehat c_g=H_\alpha^{-1}|I_1|^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_1}h^{-d}{\bf1}_{D_h}(X_i)v_\alpha(X_i/h)4A_i/r_\kappa(X_i)\) and \(\widehat g(x)=\Pi_{[1,2]}[v_\alpha(x/h)^{\mathsf T}\widehat c_g]\) on \(D_h\); set \(\widehat e(x)=r_\kappa(x)\widehat g(x)/4\).  On \(I_2\), form \(\widehat G_0=|I_2|^{-1}\sum h^{-d}{\bf1}_{D_h}(X_i)(1-A_i)v_\beta v_\beta^{\mathsf T}\) and \(\widehat s_0=|I_2|^{-1}\sum h^{-d}{\bf1}_{D_h}(X_i)(1-A_i)v_\beta Y_i\), and set \(\widehat\mu_0(x)=\Pi_{[1/8,7/8]}[v_\beta(x/h)^{\mathsf T}\mathcal F_\beta(\widehat G_0)^{-1}\widehat s_0]\), where \(\mathcal F_s(U\operatorname{diag}(\eta_j)U^{\mathsf T})=U\operatorname{diag}(\max\{\eta_j,\lambda_s/4\})U^{\mathsf T}\).  On \(I_3\), form \(\widehat Q=|I_3|^{-1}\sum h^{-d}{\bf1}_{D_h}(X_i)A_i\widehat e(X_i)^{-1}v_\gamma v_\gamma^{\mathsf T}\) and \(\widehat b=|I_3|^{-1}\sum h^{-d}{\bf1}_{D_h}(X_i)v_\gamma[ A_i/\widehat e(X_i)-(1-A_i)/(1-\widehat e(X_i))][Y_i-\widehat\mu_0(X_i)]\).  Output \(\widehat\tau_n^{(1)}(0)=\Pi_{[-3/4,3/4]}[v_\gamma(0)^{\mathsf T}\mathcal F_\gamma(\widehat Q)^{-1}\widehat b]\).  Ratios are evaluated only on \(D_h\), so every denominator is positive; flooring, clipping, and the small-sample return make this a total Borel map.  Its deterministic all-\(\kappa\) tuning is \(t=\min\{\gamma,\alpha+\beta\}\) and \(h_n=n^{-1/(2t+d+\kappa)}\).
